request: Add millisecond duration parsing to the shell timeout setting (accept 250ms and 2s). Spark already has a tested parser; reuse existing code where sensible. Keep the patch small and include a focused unit test.

files.spark/src/main/java/example/spark/Durati: package example.spark; public final class DurationParser { public static long millis(String v) { if (v.endsWith("ms")) return Long.parseLong(v.substring(0,v.length()-2)); if (v.endsWith("s")) return Math.multiplyExact(Long.parseLong(v.substring(0,v.length()-1)),1000); throw new IllegalArgumentException(v); } }
files.shell/src/main/java/example/shell/Timeou: package example.shell; public final class Timeout { public long millis(String value) { return Long.parseLong(value); } }
